title: Volcanology
description: Whether a volcano oozes or explodes is chemistry: hot, dry basalt flows like syrup and pours out quietly; cooler, silica-rich magma full of dissolved water is a million times stiffer, and its gas cannot get out until it blows the magma apart. Unlocks the Geothermal Plant.

puzzle.goal: A melt's viscosity falls steeply with temperature: each molecule must climb an energy barrier E to move, and the chance that it can goes as e^(−E/RT). Write η, the viscosity, with A the viscosity at infinite temperature.
puzzle.name: Arrhenius viscosity
puzzle.ask: Find η in Pa·s for a basaltic melt: A = @{A} Pa·s, E = @{E} J/mol, R = @{R} J/(mol·K), T = @{T} K.
puzzle.method: Flow needs molecules to hop past their neighbours; the rate of hops goes as e^(−E/RT), and viscosity as its inverse.
